functions.name: getEvents
functions.description: Events of every enabled calendar between two local ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Recurring series appear once, with their rule.

functions.name: addEvent
functions.description: Adds an event to the calendar selected in the main window (or the first writable one).

functions.name: modifyEvent
functions.description: Changes fields of an event (whole series for recurring events).

functions.name: deleteEvent
functions.description: Deletes an event (whole series for recurring events).

functions.name: hasWritableCalendar
functions.description: True if at least one enabled calendar can take new events.

events.name: onCalendarsChanged
events.description: A calendar was added, removed, turned on/off or became read-only/writable.
